Join us in shaping the future of digital manufacturing at Nobia Park!
At Nobia Park, we're building one of Europe's most modern manufacturing environments. Our new factory combines advanced automation, digitalization, and lean operations to create a highly efficient and future-focused production setup.
We are looking for a Commercial/Sourcing SAP Solution Architect to help design and develop SAP solutions that support our commercial and supply chain processes. Join Nobia's transformation journey and help build the future digital landscape at Nobia Park.
Where we are right now
Nobia is in one of the most exciting phases in its history. As part of our transformation journey, we are implementing a new SAP S/4HANA landscape while modernizing processes and systems across our business. At the heart of this transformation is Nobia Park in Jönköping, one of Europe's most automated and sustainable kitchen factories.
As our digital landscape evolves, the need for scalable and integrated solutions continues to grow. In this role, you will drive solution design across sourcing, order management, logistics, and manufacturing processes, working closely with business stakeholders, developers, consultants, and architects to deliver integrated and scalable solutions
About the role
As a Commercial/Sourcing SAP Solution Architect, you will design, implement, and support business-critical solutions within our SAP S/4HANA environment. Acting as the link between business needs and technical delivery, you will ensure solutions are aligned with both business objectives and architectural standards. The role combines solution architecture, stakeholder collaboration, and continuous improvement in a highly automated manufacturing environment.

Your responsibilities

Translate business requirements into scalable and effective SAP solutions within Sales & Distribution and Sourcing processes.

Design and support integrations between SAP S/4HANA and legacy or third-party systems.

Lead workshops and collaborate closely with business stakeholders to define requirements and future ways of working.

Work alongside developers, functional consultants, process owners, and other architects to deliver high-quality solutions.

Drive continuous improvement initiatives and identify opportunities to streamline processes and increase efficiency.

Location: Nobia Park, Jönköping. In this role you be able to work remotely on occasions but must be prepared to on weekly basis visit our factory Nobia Park in Jönköping.
Who you are
You are a proactive and collaborative professional who enjoys bridging business needs and technology. You thrive in complex environments, challenge existing ways of working, and build strong relationships across functions and countries.
Most importantly, you are motivated by contributing to Nobia's transformation and helping shape the future digital architecture of our business.
We believe you bring

Extensive experience with SAP Sales & Distribution (SD) and sourcing processes in complex business environments.

Strong knowledge of SAP configuration, solution design, and integrations across modules such as SD, MM, WM, PP, and FI.

Experience translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions and driving initiatives from design through implementation.

Understanding of commercial, logistics, and supply chain processes within manufacturing, retail, or trade environments.

Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills, combined with fluency in English and Swedish.

It is highly desirable if you have

Experience with SAP S/4HANA implementations.

Experience working in manufacturing or make-to-order (MTO) environments.

Knowledge of SAP Advanced ATP (aATP), Variant Configuration, and SAP EWM or similar warehouse management systems.

Experience integrating SAP with external systems and Fiori applications.

Basic knowledge of ABAP, debugging, and ITIL-based support and change management processes.

About Nobia
Nobia is Europe’s leading kitchen specialist and part of everyday life for millions of people, with the kitchen playing an increasingly important role in modern homes. The Group consists of eighteen strong brands, including Marbodal, HTH, Sigdal, and uno form. Curious to learn more? Visit Nobia Park.

If you’re looking to make the best co-op games in the world, you’ve come to the right place. We're proud to have some of the best game makers and collaborators in the industry working with us. What's more, we're a fun bunch of game developers, who love to indulge in our passion for video games together. Our games are not for everyone. Are they for you?
We are now looking for a Senior Game Designer
Join the Helldivers 2 team and expand our mission toolbox with more systemic variables, more dynamic objectives and more room for emergent shenanigans.
This is a hands-on role. You’ll come up with ideas for missions and game modes, then build, script, balance and debug them yourself in the engine.
What you'll do:
From Ideation to Game: Create missions. You’ll draft the core loop, flow and win/fail conditions, then script the working prototype yourself

Design for Modular Worlds: Create mission structures and objectives that work with our semi-procedural map generation

Design for Sandbox Emergence: Create mechanics that cut across mission objectives to spark unexpected encounters

Engine Scripting: Script objective flows, encounters, interactable objects and success/fail states in our in-house engine

Stress-Test & Debug: Test and debug your own setups, chasing down edge cases, logic breaks and performance issues so your missions hold up in live multiplayer

Cross-Discipline Collaboration: Work closely with Level Design, Tech Design, Code, UI, Art and Audio

Iterate with Live Data: Use telemetry, completion rates and player feedback to balance and improve missions after release

Mentor & Lead: Share best practices in encounter flow, system design, and design documentation with other designers.

Who you are:
You’re as passionate about co-op shooters as we are. You’re friendly and helpful, but also efficient, hard-working and dedicated to the game design craft. You also…

Have about 5+ years of game design experience in AA/AAA, with at least one shipped title where you personally implemented missions, encounters or systems

Are comfortable scripting in the engine (Lua, Python, C# or similar). You can build mission logic and state machines without relying on engineers for the basics

Are a Systems Thinker who understands player psychology, systemic design, pacing and core loops

Have Autonomy & Problem-Solving skills that take a high-level pitch like “a multi-stage sabotage operation against an Automaton strongpoint”, break it down, greybox it and see it through to release

Are able to write Clear design docs and explain your decisions to other disciplines

Have Strong Co-op Sensibilities, to know what makes shared victory feel earned and team failure feel hilarious rather than cheap

Are a Master of Emergent Sandbox Chaos, to balance objectives around unpredictable systems like roaming AI, physics and destructible environments

Have Great English skills, both written and spoken

How to apply
If you think that this position matches your background and skills, we would love to hear from you.
Please submit your CV in English as soon as possible. We ask that your application always include relevant work samples or a link to your portfolio.
We interview candidates continuously and hire when we find a good fit.
Practical Information
Scope: Full-time: 40 hours per week with initial 6 month probation period

Location: Office first, hybrid solution possible with minimum 3 days per week in the office

Eligibility: You need to be eligible to work in Sweden.

We are a pet friendly office! You can expect to find dogs and occasionally some cats around.
What we offer
Arrowhead Game Studios is a growing team of about 140+ people, best known for our co-op titles. Despite our size, we remain a friendly and down to earth bunch, who love to indulge in our passion for video games together.
Located in the heart of Södermalm, in Fatburen in the middle of the Game Dev scene we enjoy everything Stockholm has to offer. There are a lot of different types of activities immediately available on our doorstep.
Our talented developers are crucial to our success, therefore we put a lot of emphasis in creating and maintaining a prosperous culture. We’re committed to open and transparent communication. Your ideas are welcomed, valued, appreciated - the ceiling for creative discussions is high.
We also have numerous work benefits for all our employees. You can read about them here!

The Faculty of Engineering and Health Sciences provides education and conducts research in engineering, health and information design, with a clear focus on addressing societal challenges. Our research is carried out in close collaboration with external partners, both nationally and internationally, and contributes to knowledge development and innovation. Through our collaboration platforms, we bring together academia, the public sector and industry to jointly drive knowledge development and strengthen the relevance of research and education. Education at all levels is research-based and closely aligned with the needs of society and working life. Together, we contribute to sustainable societal development.The Faculty comprises three departments with a total of approximately 500 staff.The Department of Engineering Sciences brings together a large part of the University’s Bachelor of Science in Engineering and Master of Science in Engineering programmes in fields such as energy engineering, mechanical engineering, robotics, building engineering, environmental engineering and industrial systems. The department conducts internationally recognised research focusing on future energy and industrial systems. Collaboration with industry and society is central to developing sustainable, resource-efficient and competitive solutions for the society of tomorrow.
 
Employment information
Employment: Temporary employment
 
Period of employment/Start date: 2027-02-01
 
Scope: Full time
 
Number of positions: 1
 
Closing date for application: 2026-12-18
 
Campus location: Västerås
 
School: Faculty of Engineering and Health Sciences (FTH)/Department of Engineering Sciences (ITV)
 
Third-cycle subject: Energy and environmental science
Admission to third-cycle (doctoral) education is regulated in MDU’s admission regulations, which compile national and local rules for eligibility and admission to doctoral studies at Mälardalen University. https://www.mdu.se/en/malardalen-university/education/third-cycle-studies
 
The doctoral position includes full-time employment as a doctoral student for the duration of the education, which corresponds to four years.
Position description
The doctoral student will work in the PyroMet project, where we develop a computational fluid dynamics (CFD)-based digital twin of an industrial slag fuming furnace together with Boliden, Linde and Luleå University of Technology. The research focuses on understanding and modelling reactive multiphase flows at high temperature, where gas and slag interact through chemical reactions. The student will develop physics-based models of the fluid flow, heat transfer and reactions in such systems, and will use machine learning to build fast simulation methods that keep the accuracy of high-fidelity CFD. The aim is to support both the experimental and numerical activities of the project, further develop the existing numerical modelling framework for submerged injection, and optimise the relevant system components to improve the efficiency and performance of the slag-fuming process.
 
The work combines theoretical and experimental fluid dynamics with modern computational tools, Optimisation methods and also data-driven methods. Part of it will be done together with the industrial and academic partners.
 
The doctoral student is responsible for his own doctoral education, following the individual study plan. This includes planning and carrying out research together with supervisors and colleagues, publishing the results in peer-reviewed journals, and completing 60 credits of courses.

Then you should apply and become part of our department Customer Metering & Settlement Solutions as a Functional Consultant and use your talent to reach Vattenfall's business goals.
Customer Metering & Settlement Solutions, which is part of Customer IT that develops and operates specialized IT solutions based on SAP IS-U and SAP CRM supporting all Nordic business units in Vattenfall that have a customer relation.

As a SAP IS-U Consultant (Metering and Supplier switch), you are responsible to provide expertise to ensure that stable and reliable solutions are designed, developed, implemented and maintained and you will contribute to quality assurance activities to meet business needs.

Service Notification/Order
EDM

At Toyota Material Handling Europe, we create the technology that keeps the world moving. With over 13,500 colleagues, we are passionate about supporting companies of all sizes in meeting today's and tomorrow's material handling challenges. We recognize that our industry is essential-and often critical-to everyday life and society as a whole.
From our headquarters in Mjölby (Sweden) and Willebroek (Belgium), to our sales companies across Europe and our factories in France, Italy, and Sweden, you can be part of an extraordinary journey. Together, we are moving the world towards easier, more sustainable solutions.
The Position
At Toyota Material Handling Europe, we are now looking for a structured and proactive Project Coordinator Manager to join our strong team within Service & Logistics department. We have a very active role in all development projects around the R&D centers in Europe and in this role, you will manage the complete lifecycle of the products - from concept and development through industrialization and production launch until the usage of our products at our customer sites, all from an aftermarket perspective.
Together with your colleagues you will provide valuable input to ensure that aftermarket requirements are captured, and you will follow up on key activities to secure successful project outcomes. You will work in cross-functional project teams where you will play a central role in ensuring that all spare parts data and information are accurate, complete, and available throughout the project lifecycle.
You will report to the Manager of Parts Project Coordination
Your responsibility
Participate as a core team member in product development projects, representing the Service & Logistics function and ensuring requirements and activities are identified, coordinated, and followed up.
Collaborate closely with multiple departments across Toyota Material Handling, including Project Management, Product Management, R&D, Purchasing, Production, Order Management, and Aftermarket.
Manage spare parts related activities together with key suppliers, including external truck manufacturers producing products under Toyota brands (OEM).
Keep the organization informed and engaged regarding project status, milestones, and ongoing activities.
Follow the Engineering Change process in development projects, ensuring aftermarket requirements are validated and implemented in ERP systems.
Ensure all spare parts are accurately documented in Spare Parts Catalogues and available for ordering through ERP systems (SAP).
Work cross-functionally to continuously improve processes, ways of working, and collaboration across departments.
Ensure compliance with TMHE policies, guidelines, and requirements.
Your Profile
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence, collaborate, and build strong relationships at all levels of the organization.
Well organized and detail oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a structured and efficient manner.
Proactive and driven, with a continuous improvement mindset and a passion for developing both processes and ways of working.
Experience working in cross-functional teams and collaborating across larger organizations.
Experience or knowledge of Toyota Material Handling products is considered an advantage.
Fluent in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.
Experience working with systems such as SAP, Enovia, and the Microsoft Office suite.
A degree in Engineering, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or equivalent professional experience.
Our Offer
At Toyota Material Handling Europe, we're more than a global leader in a fast-paced industry-we're a collaborative team driven by innovation, continuous growth, and creating real value for our customers. Our diverse and international environment offers a workplace where your ideas are valued, and your contributions can make a meaningful impact. This position is based in Mjölby, Sweden, with the opportunity to work in a hybrid arrangement, combining on-site and remote work.
We offer a competitive benefits package, including an annual bonus and flexible working arrangements that support a healthy work-life balance. You'll have clear goals, strong support from senior leadership, and excellent opportunities for professional growth and career development. We foster an environment where you can build a rewarding career while contributing to meaningful work that helps shape the future of our industry.

At Husqvarna Group, innovation is in our DNA. With over 330 years of heritage and a passion for pioneering technology, we design and deliver world class products and solutions for forest, park, garden and construction care. From robotic lawn mowers to cutting-edge chainsaws and sustainable battery systems, we’re shaping the future - and we want you to be part of it.
As a Digital Project Manager, you will join a team that delivers digital solutions across multiple customer touchpoints using agile, value-driven development in a close collaboration with different stakeholders. By bridging business stakeholders, customer experience, and cross-functional teams, this role reduces fragmentation, increases alignment, and accelerates value delivery. It provides a single point of accountability for initiatives from discovery to optimization, ensuring that learning, prioritization, and execution are guided by customer insight, data, and strategic intent. You will report to Katja Eriksson, Optimization & Governance Manager.
About the role:
In this role, you will lead digital initiatives end-to-end, from early idea exploration and discovery through launch and continuous optimization. You will coordinate and collaborate closely with customer experience (CX) teams, development, marketing, and external stakeholders to ensure seamless execution. A key part of your work will be to ensure that all initiatives are grounded in data, insights, and real customer needs.
Transparency is central to how we work - you will create clear visibility into progress, decisions, and priorities for all stakeholders. Documentation is also an essential part of the role, ensuring that learning, requirements, and processes are captured and shared in a structured and accessible way.
You will follow up on goals, create transparency, and support prioritization through agile ways of working. Acting as the primary point of contact for stakeholders, you will keep the overall picture together and ensure alignment across the organization and external parties.
About you:
You’re proactive, pragmatic, and collaborative - prestige‑less, curious about the digital landscape, and comfortable driving change across diverse stakeholders. You ask for help when needed to move the work forward.
Your skills and background:
Relevant education in UX or digital marketing, or equivalent professional experience
Several years of experience in agile project management
Strong stakeholder management skills
Digital savvy, with hands-on experience using data and insights to guide initiatives and decisions
Ability to work with high transparency and maintain clear, structured documentation throughout the entire project life cycle.
Experience from agency/consultancy is considered a plus but not a requirement
Fluent in Swedish and English, both spoken and written

 
Location
This position will be based in Huskvarna, Sweden. We believe in a dynamic, energized workplace and day-to-day collaboration, and we meet in the office at least 4 days a week (80%).

Please submit your application in English as soon as possible as we will review applications on an ongoing basis. We do not accept applications via e-mail due to GDPR regulations.

For questions about the recruitment process, reach out to Talent Acquisition Partner Nina Hallin at nina.hallin@husqvarnagroup.com.

Shape the future of Swedish infrastructure
HOCHTIEF is one of the world's leading infrastructure and construction groups, employing approximately 38,000 people worldwide. The OL31 Project forms part of the Ostlänken programme, one of Sweden's largest and most important railway infrastructure investments. ·        Act as the operational link between the environmental function and the production organization.

·        2-4 years of experience in environmental coordination within construction, civil engineering, infrastructure, or similar projects.

·        Experience with environmental inspections, soil and material management, water management, and chemical management.

·        Structured, proactive, and solution-oriented approach to work.
·        Good knowledge of Swedish and English, both written and spoken.
·        Valid Category B driving license.
 Preferred Qualifications
·        Experience working on large-scale infrastructure or railway projects.
·        Knowledge of Swedish environmental legislation and authority requirements.
·        Experience working with environmental permits, compliance monitoring, and contractor environmental management.
·        Experience supporting environmental investigations and corrective action processes.
·        Familiarity with Trafikverket's environmental requirements and project environments.
·        Relevant academic background in Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Civil Engineering, or a related field.
Language Requirements
·        Fluent Swedish, preferably native-level or equivalent proficiency.
·        Professional English language skills, both written and spoken.
 We Offer
The opportunity to work on one of Sweden's largest and most complex infrastructure projects.
An international working environment within a leading global construction company.
Long-term project involvement with significant responsibility and influence.
The chance to contribute to the development of critical rail infrastructure in Sweden.

Legitimerad speciallärare med inriktning mot matematikutveckling till IES Sigtuna 

Vill du arbeta på en skola där specialpedagogisk kompetens spelar en central roll för att varje elev ska lyckas? 

Internationella Engelska Skolan Sigtuna söker en engagerad och legitimerad speciallärare med kompetens inom matematikutveckling. Vi söker dig som vill säkerställa att våra elever får rätt stöd, vid rätt tidpunkt och utifrån sina individuella behov, med särskilt fokus på elever som behöver stöd i matematik. 

Du har höga förväntningar på alla elevers förmåga att utvecklas och lyckas. Du är trygg i din profession, väl insatt i specialpedagogiska arbetssätt och van vid att omsätta dina kunskaper i praktiken. Du ser till elevens hela skolsituation och förstår att framgångsrika insatser bygger på nära samarbete mellan elev, vårdnadshavare, lärare, elevhälsa och skolledning. 

IES Sigtuna är en mångkulturell och tvåspråkig skola. Du behöver därför kunna kommunicera obehindrat på svenska och väl på engelska. 

Om rollen 

Som speciallärare arbetar du både direkt med elever och konsultativt gentemot skolans lärare. Beroende på elevernas behov arbetar du enskilt, i mindre grupper och i klassrummet. 

En viktig del av uppdraget är att kartlägga och stödja elevers matematiska utveckling. Du planerar, genomför och följer upp riktade insatser för elever som behöver särskilt stöd i matematik. Du handleder även lärare i hur matematikundervisningen kan anpassas och göras mer tillgänglig. 

Du blir en viktig del av skolans SEN-team och arbetar nära elevhälsoteamet, vår Student Care Manager, våra Academic Managers och skolledningen. Tillsammans utvecklar ni skolans arbete med extra anpassningar, särskilt stöd, skolnärvaro och tillgängliga lärmiljöer. 

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter 

• Undervisa och stödja elever enskilt, i mindre grupper och i klassrummet. • Kartlägga elevers matematiska utveckling och identifiera hinder för lärande. • Planera, genomföra och utvärdera riktade stödinsatser i matematik. • Handleda lärare i anpassad och tillgänglig matematikundervisning. • Genomföra pedagogiska kartläggningar och utredningar. • Utarbeta, följa upp och utvärdera åtgärdsprogram. • Dokumentera insatser och elevärenden i ProRenata. • Arbeta med elever som har problematisk skolfrånvaro. • Observera lektioner och handleda lärare kring extra anpassningar, särskilt stöd och tillgängliga lärmiljöer. • Delta i möten med elever, vårdnadshavare, kollegor och externa aktörer. • Samverka med elevhälsan och skolledningen kring stödinsatser. • Bidra till utvecklingen av skolans elevhälsoarbete. 

Vi söker dig som 

• har svensk lärarlegitimation och speciallärarexamen med inriktning mot matematikutveckling, • har kunskap om matematiksvårigheter och metoder för att stödja elevers matematiska utveckling, • har erfarenhet av pedagogiska kartläggningar, utredningar och åtgärdsprogram, • har erfarenhet av elever med neuropsykiatriska funktionsnedsättningar och andra behov av särskilt stöd, • har god förståelse för skolans styrdokument och bestämmelser om särskilt stöd, • uttrycker dig obehindrat på svenska och kan kommunicera väl på engelska, • arbetar strukturerat, självständigt och lösningsorienterat, och • har lätt för att skapa goda relationer och samarbeta med andra. 

Erfarenhet av problematisk skolfrånvaro och dokumentation i ProRenata är meriterande. 

Om IES Sigtuna 

Internationella Engelska Skolan Sigtuna är en tvåspråkig F–9-skola med cirka 600 elever. Undervisningen bedrivs på svenska och engelska i en internationell och mångkulturell miljö. 

Hos oss står kunskap, trygghet och höga förväntningar i centrum. Vi arbetar tillsammans för att skapa en lugn och välstrukturerad skolmiljö där eleverna kan fokusera på sitt lärande och utvecklas både akademiskt och socialt. 

Som medarbetare blir du en del av ett engagerat och internationellt kollegium som värdesätter samarbete, tydlighet och professionellt ansvar. 

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan via IES Careers!
